<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm) are: 142.60, 133.69, 133.25, 132.62, 130.15 (twice), 129.32, 128.37, 128.16, 127.72, 127.15 (twice), 126.45, 125.88, 125.73, 125.50 – a total of 16 signals corresponding to aromatic carbons. The remaining peaks (166.40 carbonyl, 52.24 aliphatic) are not aromatic. Hence the compound contains 16 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>16</final_answer>
